categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor industry focusing on three main segments: large-diameter silicon materials, silicon components, and large-size semiconductor silicon wafers. These products are used mainly in integrated circuit etching equipment and semiconductor manufacturing. The company also engages in research, production, and sales of related application products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include large-diameter single crystal silicon manufacturing without magnetic fields, solid-liquid interface control, thermal field optimization, and advanced processing techniques for silicon components such as micro-hole drilling and surface polishing. The company also develops rapid CVD-SiC coating technology and controls crystal grain structure to enhance product performance. Production methods involve precise crystal growth, slicing, grinding, etching, and polishing to meet high semiconductor standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are semiconductor silicon component manufacturers in Japan, South Korea, and China, including well-known companies like Lam Research, Tokyo Electron, Samsung, SK Hynix, Intel, and TSMC. The company serves integrated circuit manufacturers and plasma etching equipment producers, with a growing domestic Chinese market presence due to local semiconductor capacity expansion and supply chain localization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Jinzhou, Liaoning Province, and subsidiaries in Beijing, Fujian, Shanghai, and Japan. Its sales cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets, particularly Japan and South Korea, supplying silicon materials and components to global semiconductor equipment and chip manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, producing high-purity large-diameter silicon materials and silicon components used in plasma etching equipment, which are critical consumables in semiconductor wafer fabrication. It supplies materials to silicon component manufacturers who then supply semiconductor equipment makers and integrated circuit manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for large-diameter silicon materials and silicon components, enhancing product quality and technological innovation, and deepening R&D in advanced semiconductor-grade silicon wafers. The company focuses on developing customized products for next-generation plasma etching machines and improving process technologies such as defect control, surface polishing, and CVD-SiC coatings. It also emphasizes talent acquisition and strengthening domestic market penetration aligned with China's semiconductor industry growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor-grade silicon materials, silicon components, and large-size silicon wafers. The company follows a customer order plus self-stock production model, with sales mainly conducted via direct sales to large customers. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of control transfer, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the niche market of large-diameter silicon materials and silicon components for plasma etching equipment, competing globally with established suppliers in Japan and South Korea. It benefits from technological advantages, scale, and integration capabilities, positioning itself as a key upstream supplier in the international semiconductor supply chain. The company also leverages domestic market growth and supply chain localization to strengthen its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 302.7 million, a 124.19% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 41.15 million. The company’s total assets reached nearly RMB 2 billion, with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. R&D investment accounted for 8.26% of revenue, reflecting ongoing commitment to innovation. The company has expanded production capacity and improved product mix, supporting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-purity large-diameter silicon materials and precision silicon components with superior defect control and process consistency, enabling support for advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes down to 7nm and below. Its integrated production capability from crystal growth to finished silicon components offers cost and quality advantages. The company’s products meet stringent international standards and support domestic semiconductor supply chain security, providing customers with reliable, customized, and technologically advanced solutions.
